issues.description: printf argument order is inconsistent between the problem statement and the solution. The problem statement (problem_statement.md line 22) explicitly instructs: push the format string first, then the arguments. The template (template_repository/helloWorld.asm line 15) follows that order by pushing the format string (push hello). The solution (solution_repository/helloWorld.asm lines 14-15) instead pushes an integer (push 123) before pushing the format string, reversing the intended argument order. This mismatch will confuse students about the required calling convention for printf and can lead to incorrect runtime behavior.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove the extraneous 'push 123' from the solution or reorder the pushes so the format string ('push hello') is pushed before any argument pushes. Also update the solution comment to state that the format string must be pushed first to match the problem statement and avoid confusing students.
